Mohanlal's Stylist Criticizes 'Jailer 2' Makers Over Cut Scenes

Fashion designer Jishad Shamsudeen, who styles Malayalam actor Mohanlal, has criticized the makers of 'Jailer 2' after reportedly three looks created for Mohanlal's cameo were removed from the film's final cut. Shamsudeen expressed disappointment, stating, 'Our superstar reduced like this...' and vowed not to work on any future installments of the franchise.
